class.name: JRPGEventState
class.brief_description: The saved runtime state of one map event: position, facing, frame, move route progress and flags.
class.description: What changes about a map event while the map is played and must survive a save: its cell, facing direction, animation frame, progress in its move route, whether it was erased, its transparency and a "through" setting changed by a move route. The active page is not saved; it follows the conditions in [JRPGGameState]. Only the current map's events are saved (see [method JRPGGameState.set_events_map]); other maps start from their data when entered. Online, event states live on the zone server.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Replaces the state with [param data], made by [method serialize]. Every key is required; malformed data leaves the state unchanged and returns [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA].

method.name: get_cell
method.description: Returns the event's map cell.

method.name: get_direction
method.description: Returns the direction the event faces.

method.name: get_event_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the event in its map.

method.name: get_pattern
method.description: Returns the animation frame (column of the character sheet).

method.name: get_route_index
method.description: Returns the index of the next command of the event's move route.

method.name: get_route_wait
method.description: Returns the simulation steps left in the current move route wait.

method.name: get_through
method.description: Returns whether a move route forced "through" on or off, or left it to the page.

method.name: is_erased
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the event was erased (Erase Event); it stays gone until the map is entered again.

method.name: is_transparent
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the event is transparent.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns the state as a [Dictionary] of plain values.

method.name: set_cell
method.description: Sets the event's map cell.

method.name: set_direction
method.description: Sets the direction the event faces.

method.name: set_erased
method.description: Erases the event, or brings it back.

method.name: set_event_id
method.description: Sets the ID of the event in its map (from 1).

method.name: set_pattern
method.description: Sets the animation frame, kept between 0 and [constant MAX_PATTERN].

method.name: set_route_index
method.description: Sets the index of the next move route command.

method.name: set_route_wait
method.description: Sets the simulation steps left in the current move route wait.

method.name: set_through
method.description: Forces "through" on or off, or leaves it to the page.

method.name: set_transparent
method.description: Makes the event transparent or visible.

constants.constant: The event is blocked as usual, whatever the page says.
